findings.text: follow-on: the new test does not require the run-store index branch it claims to exercise, because it builds the run directories under the directory recent_claim_grace_seconds scans as a fallback, so breaking only the indexed DB read leaves the test green (EXIT=0) and only a mutation making _recent_run_names return no run names at all reddens it (EXIT=1, assert 5.0 == 30.0); place the receipts where the directory scan cannot name them so the run_store rows are the sole source of the names.

item_verdicts.done_when: grep for RACING_WINNER_WAIT_SECONDS over head's reckon/ and tests/ returns nothing, so no module exports the floor under a grace-shaped name, and the new test reaches recent_claim_grace_seconds() with root=None; the second clause, that the test fails when the indexed branch returns no run names, holds only for a whole-function failure and not for the indexed DB read.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to delete RACING_WINNER_WAIT_SECONDS, which had come to equal CLAIM_GRACE_FLOOR_SECONDS while still being re-exported through reckon.crew.dispatch, so no exported name would read as the grace but hold the floor, and to add a test that derives the grace through the run-store index branch; head removes the alias and its re-export, and adds a root=None derivation test.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commit 8f80cfff15e0cbc12d7068f631a0c2021f7b5e5b, gate base 49 passed / head 50 passed with 0 failures added, a negative_control_log path, measurement_module and measurement_cwd for the base scratch arm, and no plan edit.
item_verdicts.write_paths: 8f80cfff1 touches reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_claim_grace_follows_live_launches.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/claim-grace-has-one-name.html, all inside the declared write paths; no plan meta line and no figure path moves.

justifications.durability: the alias deletion is permanent, the name is gone and its sole re-export line removed, and the added test is a permanent pytest case through the root=None production path; the gap is precision rather than durability, because the test keeps passing whether or not the indexed read works.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's own arms show base 49 passed EXIT=0 (base-gate.log, 614b2efe) and head 50 passed EXIT=0 (head-gate.log, 8f80cfff1), so head adds one passing case and no failure; I reproduced the head arm independently in a scratch tree from git archive of 8f80cfff1 (50 passed EXIT=0) and reproduced the declared negative control reddening the new test (1 failed EXIT=1); but the test claims more than it shows, since a narrower mutation of just the indexed DB read leaves it green.
justifications.fit: the alias line and its re-export are removed in place with no compatibility shim, the new test reuses the file's fixture style and the production claim_grace_seconds as its oracle, no plan or ticket identifier reaches the code or the test name, the commit carries a conventional subject with a body stating the mechanism, and RACING_WINNER_POLL_SECONDS, which names a poll not the grace, is correctly retained.
justifications.goal_fidelity: head removes RACING_WINNER_WAIT_SECONDS entirely (grep finds no reference in head's reckon/ or tests/ and dispatch.py no longer re-exports it), so no name that reads as the grace holds the floor, while the operative value is still derived by recent_claim_grace_seconds at dispatch_claims.py:1533 and :1622; the clause to add a test through the indexed branch is only partly met, so this is short of full marks rather than a divergence.
justifications.reuse: no mechanism is re-implemented; the test builds its run store with the existing reckon.run_store.RunStore and asserts against the existing claim_grace_seconds, and the alias is deleted rather than replaced by a second floor constant, leaving one name for the floor and one derivation for the grace.
justifications.scope_discipline: 8f80cfff1 changes exactly dispatch_claims.py, dispatch.py, the claim-grace test module and a one-line evidence fragment, all inside the node's declared write paths; no plan meta line changes and no figure directory is written.
